title: Long Leave Pricing: Extended-Hold Schedule on the Hospital Stay Charge
content:
Under **Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations**, a long leave is priced at a reduced share of the schedule rate. The hospital stay daily charge follows the extended-hold schedule on the leave's privately held days already charged, counted as the days recorded on the bed-hold charges posted on the reservation, together with the hospital stay entry's days (its days as booked, net of any reversed against it): more than 30 days take the long-hold percent, 85 percent of the rate; at least 15 days and no more than 30 days take the mid-hold percent, 95 percent; fewer than 15 days take the full-rate percent, 100 percent.

**Boundaries.** A count of exactly 15 is at least 15 and takes 95 percent; a count of 14 takes 100 percent. A count of exactly 30 is no more than 30 and still takes 95 percent; 31 takes 85 percent.

**Hypothetical.** A reservation whose posted bed-hold charges record 18 days, with a hospital stay entry of 13 days, counts 31: the rate is taken at 85 percent. Had the entry been 12 days, the count would be 30 and the rate taken at 95 percent.
